headline: Western Washington finish top on six goals conceded
dek: Western Washington have lost twice in twenty-one matches and conceded six goals across all of them, closing the season with a sixteenth win, at Seattle Pacific. Their only conference defeat came at Simon Fraser, the side that finished second.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Simon Fraser scored more than any other programme and still finished below Western Washington: in this conference the goals did not decide the table.

wire.line: Tenley Leffler made 107 saves for Montana State Billings, a side that won twice all season.
